highlights:
- This release carries no gateway runtime fixes since v0.7.3. The changes are the OMP engineering baseline and upstream pin tooling.
- The OMP engineering baseline moves to v18.5.1 (#361; canary run 37140425389), the first release that retries a collab.autoStart launch whose relay is unreachable or times out (can1357/oh-my-pi#14112). Earlier OMP makes one attempt and leaves such a session unlisted until /collab, a session switch, or a restart. The embedded collaboration client and its 18.4.2 wire pin are unchanged. Mainline OMP >=18.1.20 remains required and supported.
- scripts/upstream-pins.ts derives the exact upstream lock and Windows qualification pins, hashing native tarballs only after they match registry integrity.
- View, Ask, photo-composer, native MathML, and reconnect behavior remain intact.

stableRollback: Gateway rollback does not switch the separately running OMP process. The v0.7.3 predecessor embeds the same OMP 18.4.2 collaboration client; its engineering baseline is v18.4.12, while this release uses v18.5.1. rollback --to can select only the runtimes this release retained. Preserve configuration and readiness-token state; do not silently downgrade or restart OMP. Historical fork-era recovery remains a separate stopped-service procedure in docs/UPGRADE_ROLLBACK.md.
changesToTest:
- The candidate carries no gateway runtime fixes since v0.7.3. Requalify every lane, including the session-lifecycle and Push-triage scenarios, on these exact bytes; historical receipts do not transfer.
- Qualify stock OMP v18.5.1 on the host lanes (#361; canary run 37140425389 is compatibility evidence only), including its auto-start relay retry (can1357/oh-my-pi#14112). The embedded collaboration client and its 18.4.2 wire pin remain unchanged.
- Run the Mac lane on the retained Virtualization.framework guest (macOS 27.0 build 26A428, arm64, VirtualMac2,1, ADR-033) from the Mac Studio orchestrator, and every physical Pixel lane on the Pixel 10 Pro; do not claim physical firmware, FileVault, or Secure Boot coverage.
- Existing View, Ask, photo-composer, native MathML, and reconnect boundaries remain intact.
- Complete changes and source-level verification are recorded in CHANGELOG.md and docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md at this commit. Historical platform evidence does not transfer.
plannedBoundary: - Planned qualification: Debian 13 x86-64; macOS 27.0 (26A428) arm64 in a Virtualization.framework guest (VirtualMac2,1, ADR-033); a disposable Windows Server 2025 host (the Administrator lifecycle and a fresh standard-user install); Chrome on the physical Pixel 10 Pro, including its background-Push lane; and real iPhone, iPad, and Galaxy devices in TestingBot's cloud. Every lane must pass against these exact signed bytes before stable promotion; the plan is not evidence.
candidateRollback: The selected predecessor is v0.7.3; pruning keeps it installed as the recorded rollback target. Gateway rollback does not switch or restart OMP. Historical fork-era recovery is documented separately in docs/UPGRADE_ROLLBACK.md.
